label: UKMTO: Critical
description: Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed; CMA CGM San Antonio struck by cruise missile on 5 May 2026 (8 crew injured), bulk carrier attacked by small craft 11nm W of Sirik on 3 May, and IRGC seized the Ocean Koi tanker in the Gulf of Oman on 8 May. Iran launched the Persian Gulf Strait Authority on 7 May 2026 claiming sole right to vet transits and collect tolls; 41+ incidents logged by UKMTO since late February. Red Sea elevated — Houthis resumed attacks 28 Mar 2026 in response to US/Israeli strikes on Iran; threat highest for Israel-, US- and Western-linked vessels. Gulf of Aden / Somali Basin piracy resurgent: EUREKA (IMO 1022823) hijacked off Qana, Yemen on 2 May and taken toward Somalia, following Honour 25 (22 Apr) and Sward (26 Apr) hijackings; JMIC has raised the regional threat level.
